chapter: Father and the brass band tradition
title: Personnel of the Onward Brass Band
summary: He lists the band members and their instruments, including Manuel Perez, Trepagnier, Eddie Cherrie, Adolph Alexander, the trombonists and tuba player; Bebe Matthews comes up as a drummer.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: No. No. No. Who else was in that Arnold band? I wanted to get all the other guys.
Well, I'm gonna tell you. If I can remember.
Well, they had my dad, Mario Perez, Ernest Rapana, Eddie Sherry, you heard of him. I believe Adolf Alexander.
Let's get the instruments too, I'm confused. Now, Eddie Sherry played what?

I believe he played E flat clarinet, a small clarinet. E flat I believe he played, if I'm not mistaken. But they used E flat on parades. That's what they did. And Adolf Alexander played Adolf Alexander played alto sax. I believe in. And Ernest Rapana was a snare drum player. Bass drum player. You will scratch that out. Yeah, don't worry about it.

All right then. Ernest Rapana was the bass drum player. Sometimes they would, I believe Alfred Williams played snare drum. The trumpet player had, you heard of Maurice Durand. I believe Maurice Durand was in the band at that time. Man for Rest and Maurice Durand. They had three trumpets I believe. I'm trying to think the other trumpet player. I believe, I Andrew Kimball. You heard of Andrew Kimball. I'm positive. And on the front line they had two tromones. They had Buddy Johnson, you heard of Buddy Johnson, Mal Jis. And I believe his brother Yank, he might have heard of his brother. He had two trombone brothers playing trombone
at that time. Do you remember George Peele on trombone? Did he ever play with Manuel in any

of those? I don't remember George Peele. I don't remember. If he did, he played in New Orleans with the brass band I remember. But I know he was in Chicago and he had parents living on the brass band. He was in San Anner Street in New Orleans before he died. And I didn't know much about George Peele. My daddy always talked about George Peele and George Bocquet and a lot of others. But I don't know George Bocquet. My daddy would tell me about him,
Brian Clarenidison. What about tuba player with the Arnold?

Well the Arnold band was Eddie Jackson I believe, I recall. Eddie Jackson. Did they have an alto horn or a baritone horn? Yeah. Alexander played, Adolph Alexander played baritone senior. That's Adolph's daddy. Tats' daddy. Living right about a block from here on the corner of me now. They don't stay there now, but they was staying there at the time. That's Tats' daddy. And he's passed. He passed too, yeah. He played baritone, he played euphonium too. I think he was an arranger. Well he used to write music and politics. Somebody told me to arrange some
for fellas. Bill Matthews I guess. And I remember another fine drummer too. They called Bill Matthews'

brother. I forget his other name. They called him Bebe Matthews. You ever heard of that? Yeah, he just died didn't he? Yeah. Happy just died. But this is the older, I believe this is one of the brothers that played Manny Paris around here when they had the orchestra. Yeah, Bebe had been dead long time ago. Long time ago, but he was a fine drummer.
